podcast.body: A song from the "Deja Vu" album, it was already climbing the charts and expected to reach number one when the band decided to pull it to immediately release "Ohio." Graham Nash was instrumental in this decision. "We pulled it. Nash pulled it. Credit where it's due. Then we put it out of Ohio right away."

Ep. 43 - Music and The Kent State Massacre of May 4, 1970

podcast.body: This single was released just as the Kent State protests began in May 1970. It is characterized as a quintessential early 70s sing-along folk song, focusing on the theme of improving conditions for the next generation. "Teacher Children is the epitome of early 70s sing along folk about doing better for the next generation."
